en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Grand Theft Auto VI details its climb from small-time crime to high-value jobs

entries.headline: Dragon Quest RPG 魔界樹と導かれし島 announced as a free-to-play mobile RPG
entries.summary: AUTOMATON's roundup reports that Square Enix has formally announced Dragon Quest RPG 魔界樹と導かれし島 for mobile. The free-to-play game features map exploration and command-based battles, with Yuji Horii serving as general director.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON roundup supports the announcement, platforms, model, gameplay, and director; no launch date is inferred.
entries.timeNote: Published at 12:31 Beijing time on November 15, inside the fixed edition window; the packet provides no launch date.

entries.headline: Dragon Ball FighterZ announces a new balance update
entries.summary: Bandai Namco and Arc System Works have announced a new balance update for Dragon Ball FighterZ. A release date and adjustment details have not yet been disclosed.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report attributes the announcement to both companies and says timing and details are unannounced.
entries.timeNote: Published at 23:15 Beijing time on November 15, inside the fixed edition window; the update has no announced date.

entries.headline: Mega Man: Dual Override reveals fan-designed boss Cleanser Man
entries.summary: Capcom has unveiled Cleanser Man as the winner of its Boss Design Contest. The cleaning robot will appear as a Robot Master boss in Mega Man: Dual Override, which is planned for spring 2027.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report supports the contest result, boss role, platforms, and spring 2027 window.
entries.timeNote: Published at 05:30 Beijing time on November 16, inside the fixed edition window; the game is planned for spring 2027.

entries.headline: Euro Truck Simulator 2 sets a new Steam concurrency record above 100,000
entries.summary: Euro Truck Simulator 2 reached 101,783 concurrent Steam players, its highest total since the game's 2012 release. The record came during a sale and after the November releases of the Iceland and Coaches DLCs.
entries.verification: The opened report supports the 101,783-player peak; the sale and DLCs are context, not proven sole causes.
entries.timeNote: Published at 09:38 Beijing time on November 16, inside the fixed edition window; the measurement is dated November 16 in Japan.

entries.headline: Ocarina of Time remake statistics name Redead as the leading cause of player deaths
entries.summary: ZELDA NOTES data in the Nintendo Switch App lists Redead as the enemy responsible for the most player deaths in the Nintendo Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. The statistic covers global player records.
entries.verification: The opened report attributes the ranking to global ZELDA NOTES data and gives no death count.
entries.timeNote: Published at 10:07 Beijing time on November 16, three minutes before the fixed cutoff; the figure reflects the ZELDA NOTES data visible at that time.

entries.headline: Lost Pokémon Fishing Tournament DS resurfaces, sparking a preservation dispute
entries.summary: A collector has shown a playable copy of the 2005 event-only download game Pokémon Fishing Tournament DS. A plan to encase the Nintendo DS in resin, making the software unplayable, has prompted debate in the game-preservation community.
entries.verification: The opened report separates the playable find, resin plan, and community reaction; it states no official ruling.
entries.timeNote: Published at 11:06 Beijing time on November 15, inside the fixed edition window; the original game was distributed temporarily at events in 2005.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI details its progression from small-time crime to high-value jobs
entries.summary: An interview with Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson says Jason and Lucia begin by hotwiring low-end vehicles and picking basic locks before working up to high-value jobs. Disabling cameras, stealing surveillance footage, or scouting entry points can shape robberies.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report relays named Guardian interviews and separates confirmed mechanics from the unknown progression threshold.
entries.timeNote: Published at 03:41 Beijing time on November 16, inside the fixed edition window; the game is planned for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19, 2026.

entries.headline: Hogwarts Legacy DLSS 5 test finds richer realism with a clear stylistic tradeoff
entries.summary: AUTOMATON tested the DLSS 5 Neural Rendering option added to the PC version of Hogwarts Legacy on November 5. It found more realistic detail, lighting, and materials, alongside a cooler and darker image; support is limited to RTX 50-series and RTX Spark PCs plus GeForce NOW Ultimate.
entries.verification: The opened hands-on separates supported hardware and developer tuning from the writer’s visual impressions.
entries.timeNote: Published at 16:06 Beijing time on November 15, inside the fixed edition window; the feature was added in the November 5 update.
